evidenceUse: These sources establish real-system precedent for the modeled boundaries. Because they were audited after the local probes ran, they do not convert Phase 13 into a prospective source-first discovery result and do not validate the exact synthetic protocols.

sources.title: Durable approval outbox public semantics
supports: an external call can complete while its local outcome remains unknown
later authoritative receipts settle external effects
retry identity must survive worker recovery
doesNotSupport: frontier difficulty of the repaired descendant

sources.title: Alpaca Trading CLI - Idempotent Orders
supports: a client-assigned order id can be persisted across submissions
duplicate submissions with the same client order id are rejected
the order can later be retrieved by that client order id

sources.title: Alpaca - Placing Orders
supports: orders have a client-provided unique identifier
orders can be queried by client or system identifier
order-state updates are delivered by a separate streaming interface
doesNotSupport: exactly-once execution under every broker failure mode

sources.title: Kubernetes - Controllers
supports: controllers read desired state from the API server
controllers can act on systems outside the cluster
controllers report observed state back through a separate authority

sources.title: Amazon ECS - Ensuring idempotency
supports: deployment operations accept client idempotency tokens
retrying a completed request with the same token and parameters performs no further action
changing parameters under the same token is rejected

sources.title: Argo Rollouts - Rollback Window
supports: a deployment controller treats an older manifest as a rollback
rollback behavior is controller-owned and depends on recorded rollout revision state
doesNotSupport: a client idempotency token for rollback

substrates.conclusion: The executable boundary and recovery contract descend from the source benchmark and were already measured before Phase 13.
substrates.limitation: The repaired descendant still has no counted agent trial.

substrates.conclusion: Stable client order identity and broker-owned later order state are documented real boundaries; the benchmark instantiates the same shape in a deterministic synthetic venue.
substrates.limitation: The exact venue API and lost-response schedule are synthetic, and the source audit was post-outcome.

substrates.conclusion: External deployment control, rollback state, and stable token retry are documented real patterns; the benchmark composes them into one deterministic recovery contract.
substrates.limitation: No cited system exposes the exact benchmark rollback protocol, and the source audit was post-outcome.
